personas.taste: slow, ambiguous, dark, dialogue-led, contemplative; open unresolved endings, unreliable narration, morally ambiguous people, no catharsis; long deliberate setups that earn their slowness, implication over statement, chamber-scale stories, no playfulness

fast, clear, action-heavy, elaborate visuals and sound; cathartic, decisive endings with a twist, agents who act, justice served; few turning points wasted, told directly, large-scale spectacle, some playfulness, little sentimentality

warm, light, linear, dense dialogue, saturated; compassion, relationships at the centre, transformation, hopeful just endings, no unease; unhurried but purposeful setups, said plainly, intimate scale, playful and openly sentimental
